title: mniodes kunthiana
intro: Mniodes kunthiana, commonly known as 'Mountain Mint', is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of colds, coughs, and other respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Mniodes kunthiana include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion, and its anti-inflammatory action, which may reduce pain and swelling. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils such as menthone and limonene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
